execution_clearance_scope: Safe for parent to invoke this read-only helper once; no actual transport has been verified by this static review.
redirect_qualification: urllib follows redirects by default. The helper records each actual final URL; four requests means four top-level fetch calls, not an independently logged wire-request count. Do not claim no redirects or HTTPS final endpoints until actual final URLs are examined. Pinned hashes still authenticate every accepted response byte.
error_scope: Per-request failures preserve original metadata and partial hashes; an exception before final RESULT may leave only wrapper stdout/stderr plus completed request receipts. Parent must require actual exit0 and complete PASS result.
credential_scope: No credentials or secret lookup are supplied by this helper; configured environment proxy routing remains in use.
next_step: Parent runs the four fetch calls once, then reviewer inspects actual exit/result/HTTP records and saved small-body hashes without another network download.
